# FeatureCounts

```{r}
#| echo: false

d14metadata <- read.csv("data/metadata_snakemake.csv")
d14metadata$genotype <- as.factor(d14metadata$genotype)
d14metadata$genotype <- relevel(d14metadata$genotype, "WT")
d14metadata$age_month <- as.factor(d14metadata$age_month)
d14metadata <- d14metadata %>% filter(sample_name != "D14_HET3_5")
  
annot_counts <- read.csv("data/d14_annotated_raw_count.csv")
annot_counts <- annot_counts[!duplicated(annot_counts$gene_name), ]
rownames(annot_counts) <- NULL
fcounts_mat <- (annot_counts %>% 
                          dplyr::select(-X))
dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = fcounts_mat,
                             colData = d14metadata,
                             design = ~genotype + age_month,
                             tidy=TRUE)
keep_dds <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep_dds,]
dds$group <- factor(dds$group)
design(dds) <- ~group
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
hom1_res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast=c("group", "HOM1", "WT1"),  tidy=TRUE)
hom1_res <- hom1_res %>%
  mutate( is_fus_target = case_when(
    row %in% fus_all_target_l_fdr ~ TRUE,
                         T ~ FALSE))

hom3_res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast=c("group", "HOM3", "WT3"),  tidy=TRUE)
hom3_res <- hom3_res %>%
  mutate( is_fus_target = case_when(
    row %in% fus_all_target_l_fdr ~ TRUE,
                         T ~ FALSE))

ko_res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast=c("group", "KO_HOM", "KO_WT"),  tidy=TRUE)
ko_res <- ko_res %>%
  mutate( is_fus_target = case_when(
    row %in% fus_all_target_l_fdr ~ TRUE,
                         T ~ FALSE))

```

## fus-binding

```{r}
ko_res$is_de <- ifelse(!is.na(ko_res$padj) & ko_res$padj < p_cutoff & abs(ko_res$log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff, TRUE, FALSE)
hom3_res$is_de <- ifelse(!is.na(hom3_res$padj) & hom3_res$padj < p_cutoff & abs(hom3_res$log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff, TRUE, FALSE)
hom1_res$is_de <- ifelse(!is.na(hom1_res$padj) & hom1_res$padj < p_cutoff & abs(hom1_res$log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff, TRUE, FALSE)

pct_fus_trg_de_hom1 <- sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target & hom1_res$is_de) / sum(hom1_res$is_de) * 100
pct_fus_trg_all_hom1 <- sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target) / nrow(hom1_res) * 100
pct_fus_trg_de_hom3 <- sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target & hom3_res$is_de) / sum(hom3_res$is_de) * 100
pct_fus_trg_all_hom3 <- sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target) / nrow(hom3_res) * 100
pct_fus_trg_de_ko <- sum(ko_res$is_fus_target & ko_res$is_de) / sum(ko_res$is_de) * 100
pct_fus_trg_all_ko <- sum(ko_res$is_fus_target) / nrow(ko_res) * 100

table_hom1 <- matrix(c(sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target & hom1_res$is_de),
              sum(hom1_res$is_de) - sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target & hom1_res$is_de),
                      sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target), 
                      nrow(hom1_res) - sum(hom1_res$is_fus_target)),
                     nrow = 2)
fisher_test_hom1 <- fisher.test(table_hom1)

table_hom3 <- matrix(c(sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target & hom3_res$is_de),
              sum(hom3_res$is_de) - sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target & hom3_res$is_de),
                      sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target), 
                      nrow(hom3_res) - sum(hom3_res$is_fus_target)),
                     nrow = 2)

fisher_test_hom3 <- fisher.test(table_hom3)

table_ko <- matrix(c(sum(ko_res$is_fus_target & ko_res$is_de), 
                     sum(ko_res$is_de) - sum(ko_res$is_fus_target & ko_res$is_de),
                     sum(ko_res$is_fus_target), 
                     nrow(ko_res) - sum(ko_res$is_fus_target)),
                    nrow = 2)

fisher_test_ko <- fisher.test(table_ko)

plot_data <- data.frame(
  category = c("DE genes", "All genes", "DE genes", "All genes", "DE genes", "All genes"),
  percentage = c(pct_fus_trg_de_hom1, pct_fus_trg_all_hom1, 
                 pct_fus_trg_de_hom3, pct_fus_trg_all_hom3, 
                 pct_fus_trg_de_ko, pct_fus_trg_all_ko),
  dataset = c("HOM1", "HOM1",
              "HOM3", "HOM3",
              "KO", "KO")
)

max_y_pos_hom1 <- max(plot_data$percentage[plot_data$dataset == "HOM1"], na.rm = TRUE) + 1
max_y_pos_hom3 <- max(plot_data$percentage[plot_data$dataset == "HOM3"], na.rm = TRUE) + 1
max_y_pos_ko <- max(plot_data$percentage[plot_data$dataset == "KO"], na.rm = TRUE) + 1

p1 <- plot_data %>% filter(dataset == "HOM3") %>% ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(category), 
             y = percentage, fill = as.factor(category))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("Percent of Fus-binding genes") +
    facet_grid(~dataset, labeller = labeller(dataset = c(HOM3 = hom_label))) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    ylim(0,21) +
  guides(fill="none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", purple_color)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max_y_pos_hom3, 
           label = paste("p =", formatC(fisher_test_hom3$p.value, 
                                        format = "e", digits = 2)), hjust = 0.5)

p2 <- plot_data %>% filter(dataset == "KO") %>% ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(category), 
             y = percentage, fill = as.factor(category))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("") +
    ylim(0,21) +
    facet_grid(~dataset, labeller = labeller(dataset = c(KO = ko_label))) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  guides(fill="none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", green_color)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max_y_pos_ko, label = paste("p =", formatC(fisher_test_ko$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)), hjust = 0.5)

pct_de_genes <- p1 + p2
pct_de_genes
```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
plot_volcano <- function(df_plot, title, color_non_target, color_target){
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    arrange(is_fus_target) %>%
    mutate(case = case_when(
      padj < p_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff & is_fus_target ~ "Target",
      padj < p_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff &  !is_fus_target ~ "Non-target",
      TRUE ~ "E"
    ),
  padj = case_when(
  padj < 1e-20 ~ 1e-20,
  T ~ padj
  ))
  
  df_plot %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(row %in% c("Taf15","Ewsr1","Fus"), row, "" )) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label=label)) + 
    geom_point(aes(colour = case,
                   size = is_fus_target)) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(1, 1)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Target" = color_target, 
                                   "Non-target" = color_non_target, 
                                   "E" = mixed_color)) +
      cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) +
    guides(colour = "none", size = "none", shape="none") +
    xlim(-1.5,1.5) + #ylim(-0.1,15) +
    labs(y = expression(-Log[10]~P), x = expression(Log[2]~fold~change))
}

```

```{r}
hom1_volcano <- plot_volcano(hom1_res, paste("1 month", hom_label, "vs", wt_label), light_purple_color, purple_color)

hom3_volcano <- plot_volcano(hom3_res, paste("3 months", hom_label, "vs", wt_label), light_purple_color, purple_color)

ko_volcano <- plot_volcano(ko_res, paste("3 months", ko_label, "vs", wt_label), green_color, dark_green_color)
```

# overlap

```{r}
df1 <- hom3_res
df2 <- ko_res
filtered_df1 <- df1 %>%
  filter(pvalue < 0.05)

filtered_df2 <- df2 %>%
  filter(pvalue < 0.05)

# Find genes with padj < 0.05 in at least one dataframe
genes_padj_lt_05 <- unique(c(
  df1$row[df1$padj < 0.05],
  df2$row[df2$padj < 0.05]
))

overlapping_genes <- intersect(
  intersect(filtered_df1$row, filtered_df2$row),
  genes_padj_lt_05
)

genes_padj_lt_05_df1 <- (df1 %>% filter(padj < 0.05))$row
genes_padj_lt_05_df2 <- (df2 %>% filter(padj < 0.05))$row

overlapping_genes <-  intersect(genes_padj_lt_05_df1, genes_padj_lt_05_df2)
df1 %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  filter(row %in% filtered_df2$row)

venn_d <- draw.pairwise.venn(area1=length(genes_padj_lt_05_df1), area2=length(genes_padj_lt_05_df2),cross.area=length(overlapping_genes), category=c(hom_label,ko_label),fill=c("Red","Yellow"), lwd = 0, fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans")
```

```{r}

df1 <- hom3_res
df2 <- ko_res

all_genes <- union(df1$row, df2$row)

sum_df <- tibble(row = all_genes) %>%
  left_join(df1 %>% select(row, p1 = pvalue, padj1 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  left_join(df2 %>% select(row, p2 = pvalue, padj2 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj1) | padj1 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p1) & p1 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    ),
    sig2 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj2) | padj2 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p2) & p2 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    )
  )

deg_df <- sum_df %>%
  filter(sig1 != "not sig" | sig2 != "not sig")

heat_df <- deg_df %>%
  dplyr::count(sig1, sig2)

ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = sig1, y = sig2, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "N genes", low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "hom3 status",
    y = "KO status",
    title = "Overlap of DEGs by significance type"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

cat_df <- deg_df %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      sig1 == "padj<0.05" & sig2 == "padj<0.05" ~ "padj both",
      sig1 == "padj<0.05" & sig2 == "p<0.05 only" ~ "hom3 padj & KO p-only",
      sig1 == "p<0.05 only" & sig2 == "padj<0.05" ~ "KO padj & hom3 p-only",
      sig1 == "padj<0.05" & sig2 == "not sig" ~ "hom3 padj only",
      sig1 == "not sig" & sig2 == "padj<0.05" ~ "KO padj only",
      sig1 == "p<0.05 only" & sig2 == "not sig" ~ "hom3 p-only",
      sig1 == "not sig" & sig2 == "p<0.05 only" ~ "KO p-only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig in either"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(category) %>%
  filter(category != "not sig in either") %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = category[order(n, decreasing = TRUE)]))

ggplot(cat_df, aes(x = category, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "DEG categories across hom3 and KO"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_flip()

upset_df <- sum_df %>%
  mutate(
    hom3_padj   = if_else(!is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05, 1L, 0L),
    ko_padj     = if_else(!is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05, 1L, 0L),
    hom3_p_only = if_else(
      (is.na(padj1) | padj1 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p1) & p1 < 0.05, 1L, 0L
    ),
    ko_p_only   = if_else(
      (is.na(padj2) | padj2 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p2) & p2 < 0.05, 1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(hom3_padj + ko_padj + hom3_p_only + ko_p_only > 0) %>%
  select(hom3_padj, ko_padj, hom3_p_only, ko_p_only) %>%
  as.data.frame()

UpSetR::upset(
  upset_df,
  sets = c("hom3_padj", "ko_padj", "hom3_p_only", "ko_p_only"),
  nsets = 4,
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of genes",
  sets.x.label = "Genes per set"
)

```

```{r}
merged <- hom3_res %>%
  dplyr::select(row,
                p1    = pvalue,
                padj1 = padj,
                lfc1  = log2FoldChange) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    ko_res %>%
      dplyr::select(row,
                    p2    = pvalue,
                    padj2 = padj,
                    lfc2  = log2FoldChange),
    by = "row"
  )

deg_df <- merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DE_hom3 = !is.na(p1) & p1 < 0.05,
    DE_KO   = !is.na(p2) & p2 < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(DE_hom3 | DE_KO) %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(
    !(DE_hom3 & DE_KO &
        !is.na(lfc1) & !is.na(lfc2) &
        lfc1 * lfc2 < 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    padj_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 &
        !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 ~ "padj both",
      !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 &
        (is.na(padj2) | padj2 >= 0.05) ~ "padj hom3 only",
      (is.na(padj1) | padj1 >= 0.05) &
        !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 ~ "padj KO only",
      TRUE ~ "no padj"
    ),
    padj_status = factor(
      padj_status,
      levels = c("padj both", "padj hom3 only", "padj KO only", "no padj")
    )
  )



```


```{r}
df1 <- hom3_res
df2 <- ko_res

all_genes <- union(df1$row, df2$row)

sum_df <- tibble(row = all_genes) %>%
  left_join(df1 %>% select(row, p1 = pvalue, padj1 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  left_join(df2 %>% select(row, p2 = pvalue, padj2 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj1) | padj1 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p1) & p1 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    ),
    sig2 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj2) | padj2 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p2) & p2 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    )
  )

# Only genes that are significant in at least one condition
deg_df <- sum_df %>%
  filter(sig1 != "not sig" | sig2 != "not sig")

alluvial_df <- deg_df %>%
  count(sig1, sig2, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = factor(sig1, levels = c("padj<0.05", "p<0.05 only", "not sig")),
    sig2 = factor(sig2, levels = c("padj<0.05", "p<0.05 only", "not sig"))
  )

ggplot(alluvial_df,
       aes(y = n, axis1 = sig1, axis2 = sig2)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = sig1), width = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey90", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = paste(after_stat(stratum), "\n(n =", after_stat(count), ")")),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("hom3", "KO"), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "Flows of genes between significance categories",
    subtitle = "hom3 (left) → KO (right)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

## correlation

```{r}
de_hom3_ko_merge <- merge(
  hom3_res %>% select(row, log2FoldChange, padj),
  ko_res %>% select(row, log2FoldChange, padj), 
  by="row"
)

sig_threshold <- 0.05

sig_x <- de_hom3_ko_merge$padj.x < sig_threshold & !is.na(de_hom3_ko_merge$padj.x) 
sig_y <- de_hom3_ko_merge$padj.y < sig_threshold & !is.na(de_hom3_ko_merge$padj.y)  

unique_x <- sum(sig_x & !sig_y, na.rm = TRUE)

unique_y <- sum(sig_y & !sig_x, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
colnames(de_hom3_ko_merge) <- c("Gene", "Log2FoldChange_HOM3", "Pvalue_HOM3", "Log2FoldChange_KO", "Pvalue_KO")

de_hom3_ko_merge <- de_hom3_ko_merge %>% filter(Gene %in% overlapping_genes &
                                                  Pvalue_HOM3 < 0.05 & Pvalue_KO < 0.05)
de_hom3_ko_merge <- na.omit(de_hom3_ko_merge)

de_hom3_ko_merge <- de_hom3_ko_merge %>%
  mutate(case = case_when(
  Log2FoldChange_KO > 0 & Log2FoldChange_HOM3 > 0 ~ "A",
  Log2FoldChange_KO < 0 & Log2FoldChange_HOM3 > 0 ~ "B",
  Log2FoldChange_KO > 0 & Log2FoldChange_HOM3 < 0 ~ "C",
  Log2FoldChange_KO < 0 & Log2FoldChange_HOM3 < 0 ~ "D",
  TRUE ~ "E"
  ))
highlight <- de_hom3_ko_merge %>% filter(abs(Log2FoldChange_HOM3) > 5 | abs(Log2FoldChange_KO) > 5) 
table(de_hom3_ko_merge$case)

mod1 <- (lm(de_hom3_ko_merge$Log2FoldChange_KO~ de_hom3_ko_merge$Log2FoldChange_HOM3))
summary(mod1)

coef(mod1)[2]
corr_plot <- de_hom3_ko_merge %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(Gene %in% highlight$Gene, Gene, "" )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Log2FoldChange_HOM3, y = Log2FoldChange_KO, label = Gene)) + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = case)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("A" = mixed_color, "B" = mixed_color, "C" = mixed_color, "D" = mixed_color, "E" = "gray")) +
  geom_text_repel() +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  xlim(-2,2) +
  ylim(-2,2) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm',colour = "black") +
  geom_abline(linetype=3) +
  labs(
  x = bquote(Log[2] ~ "fold change" ~ .(hom_label)~" 1M"),
  y = bquote(Log[2] ~ "fold change" ~ .(hom_label)~" 3M")
  , 
       )+
```

#IR

```{r}
intron_rows <- c(15, 16, 19, 20, 21)   # Rows corresponding to introns
exon1_rows  <- c(14)                   # Row for exon 1
exon2_rows  <- c(17, 18)                # Rows for exon 2
exon3_rows  <- c(22)                    # Row for exon 3

intron_counts <- colSums(exon_counts[intron_rows, ])
exon_counts_total <- colSums(exon_counts[c(exon1_rows, exon2_rows, exon3_rows), ])

IR_percent <- (intron_counts / (intron_counts + exon_counts_total)) * 100
sample_conditions <- rep(c("HOM1", "HOM3"), each = 5)

IR_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(exon_counts),
    Condition = sample_conditions,
    IR_Percent = IR_percent
)

  ylim(0,2)+
```

```{r}
  T ~ group
))

    summarise(mean_expr = mean(expression),
            std_error = sd(expression) / sqrt(n()))

fus_plot <- ggplot(group_summary, aes(x = group, y = mean_expr, fill=group)) +

  geom_point(data = fus_rna, aes(x = group, y = expression), 
             size = 2, color = "black") +

                width = 0.2,

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expr - std_error, ymax = mean_expr + std_error),

  ggsignif::geom_signif(
```

```{r}
df_ir <- read.table("data/ir.txt",header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

df_selected <- df_ir %>%
  select(Region, starts_with("D14_HOM3"), starts_with("D14_WT3"))

df_long <- df_selected %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Region, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("D14_HOM3", Sample), "D14_HOM3", "D14_WT3"))

df_summary <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Region, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stat_df <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    p = wilcox.test(Value ~ Group)$p.value,
    y = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = as.character(
      symnum(
        p,
        cutpoints = c(0, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.05, 1),
        symbols = c("****","***","**","*","ns")
      )
    )
  )
df_long$Group <- factor(df_long$Group, levels=c("D14_WT3","D14_HOM3"))
ir_barplot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "summary", fun = "mean",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_grid(~Region, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Retention Level") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("D14_HOM3" = light_purple_color, "D14_WT3" = "grey")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = stat_df,
    aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y, yend = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5, 
  ) +
  geom_segment(
  data = stat_df,
  aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = y, yend = y - 0.03 * y),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  linewidth = 0.5
) +
geom_segment(
  data = stat_df,
  aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = y, yend = y - 0.03 * y),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  linewidth = 0.5
)+
  geom_text(
    data = stat_df,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  )
```

#sankey plot

```{r}

df1 <- hom1_res
df2 <- hom3_res

all_genes <- union(df1$row, df2$row)

sum_df <- tibble(row = all_genes) %>%
  left_join(df1 %>% select(row, p1 = pvalue, padj1 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  left_join(df2 %>% select(row, p2 = pvalue, padj2 = padj), by = "row") %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj1) | padj1 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p1) & p1 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    ),
    sig2 = case_when(
      !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 ~ "padj<0.05",
      (is.na(padj2) | padj2 >= 0.05) & !is.na(p2) & p2 < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "not sig"
    )
  )

overlap_both <- sum_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p1), !is.na(p2),
         p1 < 0.05,
         p2 < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    sig1_overlap = if_else(!is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05,
                           "hom3 padj < 0.05",
                           "hom3 p < 0.05 only"),
    sig2_overlap = if_else(!is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05,
                           "KO padj < 0.05",
                           "KO p < 0.05 only")
  ) %>%
  count(sig1_overlap, sig2_overlap, name = "n")

sankey_plot <- ggplot(overlap_both,
       aes(y = n,
           axis1 = sig1_overlap,
           axis2 = sig2_overlap)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = sig1_overlap), width = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey90", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = paste(after_stat(stratum), "\n(n =", after_stat(count), ")")),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("hom3", "KO"), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "DEGs with p < 0.05 in both conditions",
    subtitle = "Flow between padj-significant and p-only categories"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

sankey_plot
```

```{r}
deg_df <- sum_df %>%
  filter(sig1 != "not sig" | sig2 != "not sig")

alluvial_df <- deg_df %>%
  count(sig1, sig2, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    sig1 = factor(sig1, levels = c("padj<0.05", "p<0.05 only", "not sig")),
    sig2 = factor(sig2, levels = c("padj<0.05", "p<0.05 only", "not sig"))
  )

p<-ggplot(alluvial_df,

    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(stat = "flow", nudge_x = 0.2, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("1M", "3M"), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "Flows of genes between significance categories",
    subtitle = "1M (left) → 3M (right)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
ko_sig <- ko_res %>%
  filter(pvalue < p_cutoff, abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff) %>%
  pull(row) %>% unique()

# 2) build ranked vector for GSEA from HOM3 results
# Prefer the DESeq2 'stat' (Wald score). If absent, fall back to signed -log10(p)
if (!"stat" %in% names(hom3_res)) {
  hom3_res <- hom3_res %>%
    mutate(stat = sign(log2FoldChange) * -log10(pvalue + 1e-300))
}

gene_ranks <- hom3_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(stat), !is.na(row), row != "") %>%
  filter(!(row %in% ko_sig)) %>%
  group_by(row) %>%
  summarize(stat = stat[which.max(abs(stat))], .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(stat))

geneList <- gene_ranks$stat
names(geneList) <- gene_ranks$row

gsea_hom3_uniq <- gseGO(
  geneList     = geneList,
  OrgDb        = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  ont          = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod= "BH",
  minGSSize    = 10,
  maxGSSize    = 1000,
  eps          = 0,        # exact p-values
  verbose      = FALSE
)

gsea_hom3_sig <- as.data.frame(gsea_hom3_uniq) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

dotplot(gsea_hom3_uniq, showCategory = 20)

ridgeplot(gsea_hom3_uniq, showCategory = 15)

gseaplot2(gsea_hom3_uniq, geneSetID = gsea_hom3_sig$ID[1], pvalue_table = TRUE)
```

# Cryptic

## Parse MAJIQ
```{r}
prob_cutoff <- 0.9
dpsi_cutoff = 0.05

parse_majiq <- function(control, kd, only_cryptic) {
  ref_psi_col <- paste0(tolower(control), "_mean_psi")
  kd_psi_col <- paste0(tolower(control), "_mean_psi")
  dpsi_col <- paste0(kd, ".", control, "_median_dpsi")
  df_majiq <- read.csv(paste0('data/delta_psi_voila_tsv/', control, "-", kd, "_annotated_junctions.csv"))
  df_majiq <- dplyr::rename(df_majiq,
                     refPSI=ref_psi_col, deltaPSI="mean_dpsi_per_lsv_junction") 
  
  df_majiq <- df_majiq %>% dplyr::filter(probability_non_changing < p_cutoff 
                                         & probability_changing > prob_cutoff
                                         #& event_changing == "True"
                                         & gene_name != "" 
                                         & abs(deltaPSI) >= dpsi_cutoff)

  if (only_cryptic == T) {
    df_majiq <- df_majiq %>% dplyr::filter(refPSI <= 0.05 | refPSI >= 0.9)
    df_majiq_skip <- df_majiq_skip %>% dplyr::filter(refPSI >= 0.8)
  }

    return(df_majiq)
}

```

```{r}
only_cryptic = F
df_majiq_hom3 <- parse_majiq("WT3", "HOM3", only_cryptic)
df_majiq_ko <- parse_majiq("KO_WT", "KO_HOM", only_cryptic)
```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
plot_majiq <- function(df_majiq, title){
df_majiq <- df_majiq %>%
  mutate(case = case_when(
  refPSI < 0.05 | refPSI > 0.95 ~ "Cryptic",
  T ~ "Alternative splicing",
  ),
  padjust = case_when(
  probability_non_changing < 1e-6 ~ 1e-6,
  T ~ probability_non_changing,
  ))
table(df_majiq$case)
highlight <- c("Fus", "Taf15", "Trov2", "Ewsr1")

df_majiq <- df_majiq %>%
  filter(junc_cat!="none")%>%
  group_by(paste_into_igv_junction) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(deltaPSI), with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(lsv_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(deltaPSI), with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(gene_name %in% highlight, gene_name, "" )) 
df_majiq %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs(deltaPSI), y = -log10(padjust), label = label)) + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = case), size=1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c( "lightpink", "navy", "gray" ), name = "Event") +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  xlim(0, 0.9) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = as.character(label)), max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(y = expression(-Log[10]~P), x = expression(Delta~PSI))
}
```

```{r}
convert_first_line_as_names<- function(x){names(x) <- as.matrix(x[1, ])
                                          x<-x[-1, ]
                                          x[] <- lapply(x,function(y) type.convert(as.character(y)))
                                          x <- as.data.frame(x)}

                                     lapply(function(x){x[ ,c(7,8)]})
```

## Cumulative frequency
```{r}

plot_cumulative_freq <- function(df_counts, df_deseq, genes, title,
                                 min_counts = 0.75, max_counts = 3.25,
                                 abundance_from = "baseMean",
                                 filter_pvalue = FALSE,
                                 keep_targets_outside = FALSE,
                                 show_legend = FALSE) {
  df_counts$mean_value <- log10(rowMeans(df_counts))
  df_counts$is_target <- rownames(df_counts) %in% genes

  df_deseq$is_target <- df_deseq$row %in% genes
  df_deseq <- df_deseq %>% mutate(
    zscore = make_signedZscore(log2FoldChange, pvalue)
  )

  if (abundance_from == "counts") {
    similar_abund_genes <- rownames(df_counts %>% filter(mean_value >= min_counts &
                                                        mean_value <= max_counts))
  } else {
    similar_abund_genes <- (df_deseq %>% filter(log10(baseMean) >= min_counts &
                                                log10(baseMean) <= max_counts))$row
  }
  print(length(similar_abund_genes))

  z_target <- df_deseq$zscore[df_deseq$is_target == TRUE]
  z_non_target <- df_deseq$zscore[df_deseq$is_target == FALSE]

  ks_test <- ks.test(z_target, z_non_target)
  print(table(df_deseq$is_target))

  df_plot <- df_deseq
  if (filter_pvalue) df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(pvalue < 0.05)
  if (keep_targets_outside) {
    df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(row %in% similar_abund_genes | is_target)
  } else {
    df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(row %in% similar_abund_genes)
  }

  ggplot(df_plot,
         aes(zscore, color = is_target)) +
    stat_ecdf() +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("gray", light_purple_color )) +
    guides(colour = if (show_legend) "legend" else "none", fill = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-6,6)) +
    labs(y = "Density",
         x = "Z-Score",
         title = paste("D =", round(ks_test$statistic, 2), ", p =", signif(ks_test$p.value, 2))
         )
}
```

```{r}

plot_cumulative_freq_subset <- function(df_counts, df_deseq, genes, title) {
  df_counts$mean_value <- log10(rowMeans(df_counts))
  df_counts$is_target <- rownames(df_counts) %in% genes
  
  densities <- df_counts %>% 
    mutate(value = (mean_value)) %>%
    group_by(is_target) %>%
    do({
      data.frame(x = density(.$value)$x, y = density(.$value)$y, is_target = unique(.$is_target))
    })
  
  min_counts <- 1
  max_counts <- 4
  df_deseq$is_target <- df_deseq$row %in% genes
  df_deseq <- df_deseq %>% mutate(
    zscore = make_signedZscore(log2FoldChange, pvalue)
  )
  similar_abund_genes <- (df_deseq %>% filter(log10(baseMean) >= min_counts &
                                                      log10(baseMean) <= max_counts))$row
  print(length(similar_abund_genes))

  
  z_target <- df_deseq$zscore[df_deseq$is_target == TRUE]
  z_non_target <- df_deseq$zscore[df_deseq$is_target == FALSE]
  
  ks_test <- ks.test(z_target, z_non_target)
  print(table(df_deseq$is_target))
  ggplot(df_deseq %>% 
           filter(row %in% similar_abund_genes | row %in% genes), 
         aes(zscore, color = is_target)) + 
    stat_ecdf() + 
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("gray", light_purple_color )) +
    guides(colour = "none", fill = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-6,6)) +
    labs(y = "Density", 
         x = "Z-Score",
         title = paste("D =", round(ks_test$statistic, 2), ", p =", signif(ks_test$p.value, 2))
         ) 
}
```

```{r}

make_signedZscore <- function( log2FC, pvalue){
  signedZ <- ifelse(test = log2FC > 0,
                    yes = qnorm(1 - (pvalue / 2)),
                    no = qnorm(pvalue / 2) )
  # high pass - otherwise very low P is set to Inf
  signedZ[ signedZ > 6 ] <- 6
  signedZ[ signedZ < -6 ] <- -6
  return(signedZ)
}
```

```{r}
rbp_peaks <- lapply(c("G3BP1","DDX6","CAPRIN1"), function(x)
  read.delim(sprintf("data/%s_mouse_targets.tsv", x)))
names(rbp_peaks) <- c("G3BP1","DDX6","CAPRIN1")

min_peaks <- 10
by_min_peaks <- function(d) d$gene[d$n_exonic_peaks >= min_peaks]
g3bp1_target <- by_min_peaks(rbp_peaks$G3BP1)
ddx6_target <- by_min_peaks(rbp_peaks$DDX6)
caprin1_target <- by_min_peaks(rbp_peaks$CAPRIN1)
```

```{r}
df1 <- hom3_res
df2 <- ko_res

filtered_df1 <- df1 %>%
  filter(pvalue < 0.05)

filtered_df2 <- df2 %>%
  filter(pvalue < 0.05)

# Find genes with padj < 0.05 in at least one dataframe
genes_padj_lt_05 <- unique(c(
  df1$row[df1$padj < 0.05],
  df2$row[df2$padj < 0.05]
))
upreg_genes <- intersect(
  intersect((filtered_df1 %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0))$row, 
            (filtered_df2 %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0))$row),
  genes_padj_lt_05
)

downreg_genes <- intersect(
  intersect((filtered_df1 %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0))$row, 
            (filtered_df2 %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0))$row),
  genes_padj_lt_05
)

```

```{r}
de_gene_hom3 <- hom3_res %>% filter(padj < p_cutoff &
                                  abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff) %>% .[,"row"] %>% as.vector(.)
de_gene_hom3_uniq <- setdiff(de_gene_hom3, 
                             ko_res %>% filter(pvalue < p_cutoff &
                                  abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff) %>% .[,"row"] %>% as.vector(.))

de_gene_hom3_up <- hom3_res %>% filter(padj < p_cutoff &
                                  (log2FoldChange) > logfc_cutoff) %>% .[,"row"] %>% as.vector(.)
```
